facts.fact: The report cites the Electronic Transactions Act (2022) among the laws in place.

The Revised Edition 2022 of the Electronic Transactions Act, Cap. 442, published by Government Notice 461 of 24 June 2022, gives legal recognition to electronic signatures, electronic contracts and data messages, sets duties of suppliers to online consumers, and provides for registration of cryptographic and certification service providers.
The Ministry says the government enacted the Electronic Transaction Act, 2015 under the RCIP project.
